entities.name: Global Sensemaking Question Generation
entities.description: A procedure using an LLM to generate corpus-specific questions designed to assess high-level understanding without requiring retrieval of specific low-level facts.

entities.name: Global Sensemaking
entities.description: A task type involving high-level understanding of a corpus, distinct from retrieving specific low-level facts.

entities.name: Persona Generation
entities.description: A step in the question generation process where an LLM is prompted to describe personas of hypothetical users.

entities.name: Task Identification
entities.description: A step where the LLM specifies tasks that each hypothetical user would use the RAG system to complete.

entities.name: High-level Question Generation
entities.description: A step where the LLM generates questions for each user-task combination that require understanding of the entire corpus.

relationships.description: The method is designed to evaluate RAG systems on global sensemaking tasks.
The method utilizes persona generation as a procedural step.
The method utilizes task identification as a procedural step.
The method utilizes high-level question generation as a procedural step.
Persona generation is a component of the Global Sensemaking Question Generation workflow.
Task identification is a component of the Global Sensemaking Question Generation workflow.
High-level question generation is a component of the Global Sensemaking Question Generation workflow.
